svg.text: DronePhotographer training lens: exact Qwen-VL sequence, labels, and loss on one real sample
Measured from the local `drone` environment with `transformers 5.3.0`, `Qwen2_5_VLProcessor`, and `Qwen2Tokenizer`. Current default: orientation_6d rotation representation.
orient_camera_local_6d(fx=..., fy=..., fz=..., ux=..., uy=..., uz=...)
Important detail: the processor injects a default system message even though the repo code only supplies user / assistant messages.
These 95 supervised positions include the JSON body, the closing <|im_end|> token, and the trailing newline.
2. Exact multimodal sequence layout for this sample
Bar widths below are schematic for readability. The indices and counts are exact.
The `999` image slots are already post-merge language placeholders, not raw vision patches.
This sample produces `54 x 74 = 3996` patch positions first, then merge_size `2 x 2` reduces them to `3996 / 4 = 999`.
User text starts at `1015`; assistant header ends at `1292`; the first supervised token `{"` starts at `1293`.
3. Exact prompt text given to the tokenizer
This is the repository's user prompt before chat-template wrappers are injected.
You are a drone image scorer.
Input is current image_i and an action command in camera-local frame of image_i
The action encodes the target camera orientation as target forward/up vectors.
Predict score values of image_j after applying the action.
orient_camera_local_6d(fx=..., fy=..., fz=..., ux=..., uy=..., uz=...)
The first character of your response must be '{' and the last character must be '}'.
Use keys exactly once and in this exact order: bbox_occupancy_ratio, bbox_margin_top, ...
Use numeric JSON values only. Do not use strings, null, comments, or trailing commas.
Do not output markdown, code fences, explanations, or any extra text.
Observed wrapper tokens around that prompt
The prompt-only sequence used for masking ends immediately after the assistant header newline, so `prompt_len = 1293` excludes the target JSON itself.
Selected indices from the measured input_ids / labels arrays.
The Trainer passes `labels`; the model computes standard autoregressive CE on non-masked positions only.
L = -(1 / 95) * sum log p_theta(x_t | image_i, x_<t)
ignore all labels equal to -100, average CE over the rest.
The model is not trained to recreate the prompt or the image wrappers.
It is trained only to continue the sequence with the target JSON.
6. Training run summary and GPU requirements
Measured from runs on DogWalk_v2_10k (10,000 views, 354,728 pairs). All runs use 1 epoch, lr=2e-5, effective batch=16.
Model GPU setup Batch config Time
DeepSpeed Zero-3 for 7B/9B models. Gradient checkpointing enabled for 7B/9B to fit in VRAM.
azimuth, distance, pitch) via v3 renderer
